challenge.better_approach: Looked: a bare cat of the pieces is the smallest join, but it shows only the markers, and measured 2026-11-17 9 of 25 open questions have none that a reader can find. The appendix is the part that makes it complete; reusing outline_bytes keeps one join.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That a record's Q# can be read without misreading a quoted one: open-6712e6ffac8f quotes 'answering Q#99' inside outline text. Hence the note is authoritative and the fallback reads only 'Q#n (' at the opening or 'where Q#n stands open'.
challenge.prior_art: outline_check.outline_bytes (cairn/devices/codemother/machines/outline_check/outline_check.py:181) already joins the pieces in memory; cairn.tools.question.list_open lists the open records. No command writes the join (bin/cmd holds no outline verb).
challenge.real_collision: Outline 0.6 says an answered question disappears from the outline; the Q#105 record (open-f842c97cb8d0) is still open though 11.3.5.1.1 states the answer. Not a collision: the file flags it for him to close, and CC does not answer for him.

answers.falsifier: Done: cairn outline writes the pieces in filename order then the questions section; every unresolved question id in CairnCommons/questions appears in the file; every open question carries a Q# whose marker stands in the outline, or is flagged in the section. Wrong intent: Akien reads the file and still has to go to the inbox to see a question.
answers.from_idea: none, because Akien asked in chat 2026-11-17 and the decision is recorded at /home/akien/.claude/projects/-home-akien-dev-src-cairn/memory/joined-outline-is-akiens-question-surface.md
answers.how: A joined.py beside outline_check reuses outline_bytes and appends an open-questions section built from the question corpus (grouped by Q#, each record's Q# read from a note or its opening; unnumbered ones in full); bin/cmd/outline registers it, writing ~/.akien/temp/outline.md by default. The four records that live at an outline marker but never say their number get a note naming it; the four genuinely unplaced questions get markers Q#120-Q#123 at their lines, and 0.6's next number moves to 124.
answers.traces_to: Law 1 (his answers are the novel input; one surface stops him re-deriving where a question stands) and CP4 via outline 0.6 (a question is placed at the line it bears on).
answers.what: cairn outline writes the requirements pieces joined into one file, with every open question visible in it, so Akien can field questions from one surface.

bullets.text: Measured 2026-11-17: 25 open questions, 16 visible by marker; 4 more sit at a marker their record never names (Q#101/103/106/107); 4 are genuinely unplaced; 1 (Q#105) is answered in the outline but still open.
